purpose: Convert the SEIS developer role roadmap into ready-to-scope GitHub issue packages for contributors and AI coding agents.
rules: Every issue must be small enough for one pull request.
Every issue must name its role lane, expected output, validation command, and rollback note.
Every issue must preserve SEIS truth labels for local, mock, planned, disabled, and live states where relevant.
No issue may require private data, provider keys, live SSH, or deployment access unless separately approved.

issue_packages.title: Review one SEIS product surface for state labels and accessibility
issue_packages.goal: Pick one SEIS browser-facing or documented product surface and verify that its local, mock, planned, disabled, and live states are understandable.
deliverables: One proposed improvement issue or patch
acceptance_criteria: The reviewed surface has a clear current-state label
Keyboard, mobile, or reduced-motion considerations are mentioned
The issue does not add live provider or deployment claims
issue_packages.rollback: Remove the review note or revert the scoped patch if it creates confusion.

issue_packages.title: Draft one backend or API contract for a SEIS capability
issue_packages.goal: Define inputs, outputs, errors, safety boundaries, and data assumptions for one future SEIS backend capability.
acceptance_criteria: Contract separates public demo data from live or private data
Secrets are explicitly backend-only
Rollback or deprecation path is documented
issue_packages.rollback: Remove the contract or mark it deprecated if the capability direction changes.

issue_packages.title: Plan one thin SEIS full-stack slice
issue_packages.goal: Connect one product surface, one data or API contract, validation commands, and a rollback note into a tiny vertical slice.
acceptance_criteria: The slice is small enough for one PR
Mock, planned, disabled, and live states are not mixed
The PR summary can explain current truth state
issue_packages.rollback: Revert the slice plan and linked artifacts if scope expands beyond one PR.

issue_packages.title: Create one no-mutation DevOps readiness plan
issue_packages.goal: Document how a future CI, cloud, SSH, or deployment path would be checked without live mutation.
acceptance_criteria: No live service mutation is required
SSH, cloud, and deployment actions are approval-gated
The plan names what evidence would be collected
issue_packages.rollback: Remove or revise the readiness plan if it implies unapproved live access.

issue_packages.title: Draft one SEIS database safety checklist
issue_packages.goal: Document schema, migration, backup, restore, performance, security, and privacy expectations for one data surface.
acceptance_criteria: Private data is excluded from public examples
Backup and restore expectations are named
Least-privilege concerns are mentioned
issue_packages.rollback: Remove the checklist or convert it to a draft if the data surface is not approved.

issue_packages.title: Write one provider-neutral AI route decision
issue_packages.goal: Explain one AI workflow route with local, mock, planned, disabled, and live state boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: No provider key or private data is exposed
Fallback behavior is not silent
Human approval boundaries are clear
issue_packages.rollback: Revert the decision note if it overclaims live AI capability.

issue_packages.title: Draft one local-first data pipeline contract
issue_packages.goal: Define a data pipeline plan with source, transform, quality, lineage, privacy, and warehouse assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can be described without cloud credentials
Quality and lineage are explicit
Privacy assumptions are visible
issue_packages.rollback: Remove the pipeline contract if it depends on unavailable private data.
